purpose: Evidence and rights-aware source registry for Japan Halal Checker; NOT an import manifest

current_catalog.warning: Existing records include non-Japan scoped products. Do not add dataset counts together without exact JAN deduplication.

statuses.public_open_with_conditions: Open Food Facts and MEXT: follow stated licenses
statuses.public_lookup_not_bulk_licensed: Yahoo, Rakuten, ZEN-NOH, Nicky Foods, Shokuken, MCC, Nosui, Umios, SHOWA, JAN Search

import_rules: Never import unlicensed full catalogs or proprietary competitor databases.
Preserve source URL and evidence timestamp.
Do not label product halal just because pork/gelatin words are absent.
Keep nutrition vs manufacturer-supplied ingredient vs restaurant meal data separate.
Dedupe using validated JAN-8/JAN-13; catalog IDs are not JANs.
Full-label text and additive origin require separate verification.
Use server-side keys only; do not commit secrets.
Respect terms, API quotas and robots controls.
